data.description: Full definition of a flow including dynamic inputs and cost.

inputs.description:
Dynamic input definitions. Each input corresponds to an entry node
in the flow. The caller must provide values for all `required`
inputs when calling the run endpoint.

items.description:
Defines a single input parameter for the flow.
Use the `api_key` field (recommended) or the `id` field (legacy) as the identifier in the `inputs` object when calling the run endpoint.

api_key.description:
Human-friendly identifier for this input, matching the node name.
Recommended identifier to use as the key in the `inputs` object when running the flow.

config.description:
Type-specific configuration.
For `creation` type: contains `mediaType` (image, video, audio).
For `select` type: may contain `options`.
Null when not applicable (e.g. for `text` type).

mediaType.description: For `creation` type ,  the expected media kind.

default.description: Default value if not provided by the caller. Null means no default.

id.description:
UUID-based identifier for this input. Format: `input-{nodeId}-{n}`.
Still accepted as a key in the `inputs` object for backward compatibility; prefer `api_key`.

key.description: (Deprecated) Legacy human-readable key. Superseded by `api_key`; may be absent in newer responses. Prefer `api_key`.

nodeId.description: UUID of the flow node this input feeds into.

presentation.description:
UI presentation hints for rendering the input.
Present for `text` type inputs; null or absent for other types.

required.description: Whether this input must be provided when running the flow.

type.description:
The type of input value expected:
- `creation`: Image or media file (accepts URL, base64, or creation sqid)
- `text`: Text prompt or string
- `number`: Numeric value
- `select`: Choice from predefined options

name.description: Human-readable name set by the creator.

tool_metadata.description: Metadata about the tool (UI hints, cost, categorization).

description_key.description: Translation key for the tool description.

total_cost.description: Total credit cost per execution (sum of all workflow nodes).

translation_key.description: Translation key for the tool name.

parameters.description:
You can guide the generation process and influence the light transfer with a descriptive prompt. For example, if the reference image is a brightly lit scene, adding something like "A sunlit forest clearing at golden hour" will be helpful.

You can also use your imagination to alter lighting conditions in images: transforming a daytime scene into a moonlit night, enhancing the warmth of a sunset, or even dramatic changes like casting shadows of towering structures across a cityscape.

IMPORTANT: You can emphasize specific aspects of the light in your prompt by using a number in parentheses, ranging from 1 to 1.4, like "(dark scene:1.3)".
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Base64 or URL of the reference image for light transfer. Incompatible with 'transfer_light_from_lightmap'
parameters.name: transfer_light_from_reference_image

parameters.description: Base64 or URL of the lightmap for light transfer. Icompatible with 'transfer_light_from_reference_image'
parameters.name: transfer_light_from_lightmap

parameters.description:
It allows you to specify the level of light transfer, meaning the intensity that your prompt, reference image, or lightmap will have. A value of 0% will keep your image closest to the original, while 100% represents the maximum possible light transfer.

If you enable "Interpolate from original", lower values on this slider will make the result even more similar to your original image.
Valid values range `[0, 100]`, default `100`
parameters.name: light_transfer_strength

parameters.description:
When enabled, this feature will make your final image interpolate from the original using the "Light transfer strength" slider, at the cost of sometimes restricting the generation's freedom.

If disabled, the generation will be freer and will generally produce better results. However, for example, if you want to generate all the frames of a video where a room transitions from having the lights off and very dim lighting to gradually becoming fully illuminated as a new day begins, activating this option might be useful (together with gradually ingreasing the "Light transfer strength" slider).
parameters.name: interpolate_from_original

parameters.description: When enabled, it will change the background based on your prompt and/or reference image. This is super useful for product placement and portraits. However, don't forget to disable it if your scene is something like a landscape or an interior.
parameters.name: change_background

parameters.description: Style.
parameters.name: style

parameters.description: It will try to maintain the texture and small details of the original image. Especially good for product photography, texts, etc. Disable it if you prefer a smoother result.
parameters.name: preserve_details

parameters.description: Advanced settings.
parameters.name: advanced_settings

blacks.description:
Adjust the level of black color in the image.
Valid values range `[0, 100]`, default `50`.

brightness.description:
Adjust the level of brightness in the image.
Valid values range `[0, 100]`, default `50`.

contrast.description:
Adjust the level of contrast in the image.
Valid values range `[0, 100]`, default `50`.

engine.description:
Balanced: Well-rounded, general-purpose option.
Cool: Brighter with cooler tones.
Real: Aims to enhance photographic quality. Experimental.
Illusio: Optimized for illustrations and drawings.
Fairy: Suited for fantasy-themed images.
Colorful Anime: Ideal for anime, cartoons, and vibrant colors.
Hard Transform: Significantly alters the original image.
Softy: Slightly softer effect, suitable for graphic designs.

fixed_generation.description: When this option is enabled, using the same settings will consistently produce the same image. Fixed generations are ideal for fine-tuning, as it allows for incremental changes to parameters (such as the prompt) to see subtle variations in the output. When disabled, expect each generation to introduce a degree of randomness, leading to more diverse outcomes.

saturation.description:
Adjust the level of saturation in the image.
Valid values range `[0, 100]`, default `50`.

transfer_light_a.description: Adjusts the intensity of light transfer. Advanced feature requiring practice to use effectively.

transfer_light_b.description: Also modifies light transfer intensity. Can be combined with the previous control for varied effects. Complex to master but offers more control

whites.description:
Adjust the level of white color in the image.
Valid values range `[0, 100]`, default `50`.
